# Nonprofit Web Tools
> Free web-based tools for nonprofits, built by Good Heart Tech, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that also provides free managed IT to qualifying partners.

## Hub
- URL: https://nonprofittools.org/
- Operator: Good Heart Tech — https://goodhearttech.org/
- Free MSP program: https://goodhearttech.org/for-nonprofits.html

## Tools (document & media)
- Media Converter: https://convert.nonprofittools.org/
- Image to Text (OCR): https://ocr.nonprofittools.org/
- PDF Editor: https://pdf.nonprofittools.org/
- QR Code Generator: https://qr.nonprofittools.org/
- Text Manipulator: https://text.nonprofittools.org/
- Wallpaper Generator: https://wallpaper.nonprofittools.org/
- Snippet Sharing: https://snip.nonprofittools.org/

## Tools (performance & analysis)
- Internet Speed Test: https://speed.goodheart.tech/
- Website Check: https://webcheck.goodheart.tech/
- Domain Analyzer: https://dnschecking.org/

## Tools (security & compliance)
- Password Pusher: https://push.goodheart.tech/
- Password Generator: https://password.nonprofittools.org/
- Policy Generator: https://policy.nonprofittools.org/

## Related Good Heart Tech resources
- Nonprofit Tech Navigator: https://learn.goodhearttech.org/
- Nonprofit Monitor: https://nonprofitmonitor.org/
- Free M365 audit: https://m365audit.org/
- Contact (MSP partnership): https://goodhearttech.org/contact.html
